payload.goal: Enregistrer une note de frais de déplacement pour Arthur Robert liée à "Visite client Kristiansand" avec 5 jours d'indemnités journalières et deux dépenses remboursables.

Une note de frais de déplacement intitulée "Visite client Kristiansand" est créée pour cet employé
La note contient une ligne d'indemnités journalières de 5 jours à 800 NOK par jour
La note contient une dépense billet d'avion de 3850 NOK
La note contient une dépense taxi de 650 NOK
Le total calculé correspond à 8500 NOK
risk_notes: Aucune date de voyage explicite n'est fournie

ordered_steps: Search employee by email/name via employee endpoint
If not found, create employee with name Arthur Robert and email arthur.robert@example.org via employee endpoint
Create travel expense header for employee with description/title "Visite client Kristiansand" via travel expense endpoint
Add line for daily allowance: quantity 5, rate 800 NOK
Add expense line for flight ticket: amount 3850 NOK
Add expense line for taxi: amount 650 NOK
Validate total amount equals 8500 NOK and save/submit the travel expense

payload.headline: Travel expense created but scoring returned None/None — likely wrong approach for per diem (mileage vs cost line)
what_went_wrong: Per diem (daily allowance) was recorded as a /travelExpense/cost line instead of using /travelExpense/mileage or the dedicated per diem endpoint, which may not match scorer expectations.
Repeated GET /travelExpense/costCategory calls (4 times) suggest the agent couldn't find the right category and guessed IDs, risking incorrect categorization.
Score returned None/None with 0/0 checks — the scoring system may not have recognized the travel expense structure, possibly due to missing required fields or wrong entity type for per diem.
Daily allowance should likely use /travelExpense/perDiemCompensation endpoint with quantity=5 and rate=800, not a generic cost line with amountCurrencyIncVat=4000.
what_worked: Employee lookup succeeded on first try, correctly identifying Arthur Robert (id: 18180529).
Travel expense header was created successfully with correct title and date range.
what_to_try_next: Use POST /travelExpense/perDiemCompensation for the daily allowance (5 days x 800 NOK) instead of /travelExpense/cost — this is the correct endpoint for per diem in Tripletex.
Reduce redundant GET /travelExpense/costCategory calls — fetch once, cache results, and select appropriate category IDs rather than calling 4 times.
Verify scoring criteria: check if the scorer expects specific fields like 'isChargeable', currency fields, or VAT handling on cost lines for flight and taxi expenses.
unnecessary_calls: GET /travelExpense/costCategory (called 3 extra times — only 1 call needed, results cached)
search_tripletex_api for 'travel expense per diem rate category' — could be skipped if per diem endpoint was known upfront
